# Copilot Instructions for Longhorn Manager

All guidance for contributors and coding agents lives in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)
at the repository root: architecture and navigation, coding rules, build and test
commands, commit and pull request requirements, the pull request review workflow
and output format, and the security policy. Read it before making changes or
reviewing. This file intentionally contains nothing else, so the two never drift
apart.
